citation.authors: McGowan D, Kermani A, Sheagren J, et al

cited_by.title: Rashes on dark skin: what to look for

record.population: Published literature on skin of colour (the review does not give study numbers in its abstract)
record.design: Scoping review of what is written about how infections look and are diagnosed on skin of colour: HIV, shingles, impetigo, scarlet fever, Lyme disease, toxic shock syndrome, scabies, rickettsioses and fungal infections
record.finding: The review found literature gaps, including a lack of visual examples and of precise descriptions of common infectious rashes in patients with skin of colour. The authors say the lack of good-quality resources may contribute to barriers to care.
record.note: A finding about the evidence, not about how a rash looks; "skin of colour" papers are mostly Asian, Latin American and Middle Eastern populations and are not evidence about Black skin; funding not checked.
